name: Calibration Error
source:
Calibration Error is game about you and your best friend Emily. Hijinks ensue after an unlicensed, inadvisable experiment that leaves the main character in a body not quite normal. Will you manage to return to your male body? Or maybe you’ll end up having sex with anyone around you who breathes. The choice (as long as the choice is one I wrote in advance) is up to you!

[From [url=https://apollosevengames.com/calibration-error/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
《校准错误》是一款关于你和你最好的朋友艾米丽的游戏。在一次未经许可、不明智的实验后，主角的身体变得不太正常，随之而来的是狂欢。你能回到男性身体吗？或者也许你最终会与周围任何会呼吸的人发生性关系。选择（只要是我提前写好的选择）就看你了！

[来自[url=https://apollosevengames.com/calibration-error/]官方网站[/url]]
